title: Amber Hours
author: Freek van Gool
description: A minimal, warm, rolling liquid drum and bass track in A minor at 172 BPM, 112 bars (about 2:36). Soft two-step drums with ghost snares, a sub with a fingerstyle bass, tine electric piano m9 and m11 chords, a string pad, a flute melody, vibraphone answers in the second groove and vinyl crackle. Intro, groove, break, groove with an extra layer, outro. Measured, not listened to.
